title: Implement FTS memory retrieval and compact expansion

repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.historical_evidence_note: implementation/evidence/M4-T01.json remains historical and its old schema-v4/source hashes are not used as proof of the repaired current tree
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.state_authority: one sovereign_state::StateStore / SQLite authority; sovereign-memory opens no second database or pool
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.confidence_contract: public u8 and durable INTEGER 0..100 with legacy representation consistency checks
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.lineage_and_content_digest: lineage_id/content_digest are durable, recomputed, and verified on read; caller cannot supply arbitrary durable content digest
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.contradiction_relation: same scoped subject/predicate OR same conflict_key, with scope/role overlap
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.demotion_reconsideration: uses the same contradiction relation and can restore normal injection when higher-trust truth becomes noncurrent
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.conflict_identity: initial equal-trust conflict IDs are pair-order independent
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.conflict_bridge_merge: connected unresolved conflict sets merge deterministically; historical membership is retained while current active pointers converge
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.fingerprint_invalidation: repository delta carries old->new and only exact old fingerprint digest matches are invalidated
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.atomic_lifecycle_journal: canonical lifecycle mutation and append-only event journal publication share the same StateStore transaction
repaired_m4_t01_current_tree_proof.migration_rollback: fixture creates true v3, copies/verifies v3 backup, applies deliberately failing v4, proves partial DDL/version/data rollback, then proves both original and backup remain readable/upgradeable

retrieval_contract.projection: memory_fts_projection is derived FTS5 state sharing the canonical StateStore connection
retrieval_contract.bootstrap: v4->v5 migration performs one-time canonical-to-FTS population
retrieval_contract.ordinary_mode: active + normal_injection + no unresolved conflict + unexpired only
retrieval_contract.history_mode: explicitly permits noncurrent historical records while preserving scope/kind/trust filtering
retrieval_contract.conflict_mode: explicit unresolved conflict path; kind/minimum_trust filtering preserved; ordinary fact injection bypassed
retrieval_contract.episodic_order: exact normalized failure signature/repository/tool/runtime/symbol/task filters run before broad lexical fallback
retrieval_contract.trust_order: governed > validated > observed > unreviewed before lexical rank/confidence/id

hard_bounds.over_scan_window: fail closed with no conflict result
hard_bounds.truncation: member_handles_truncated is explicit when additional matching members exist within the fully validated window

retrieval_contract.conflict_scope_fail_closed: for <=128 members every active member is scope-validated even after 16 retained handles; a later invisible role/agent member suppresses the result
retrieval_contract.compact_expansion: scope + current durable content_digest + exact full expansion handle + selected durable provenance evidence ID are validated before access counters mutate
retrieval_contract.graph: anchor required; candidate materialization and returned neighbors are hard bounded
retrieval_contract.context_integration: production MemoryHistoryProvider routes exact episodic key before optional lexical fallback and emits only C3 TrustClass::Derived evidence

resource_ownership.nuance: StateStore WAL/FULL-sync/wal_autocheckpoint defaults are not evidence of architecture-wide aggregate cache_size/mmap/WAL-health hard enforcement; this broader ownership point is not falsely claimed as M4 proof.

verification.command: CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true $HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo clippy -p sovereign-memory -p sovereign-state -p sovereign-context --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings

verification.detail: all workspace tests passed; only intentional local-model qualification/smoke tests ignored

initial_blockers: conflict mode bypassed public kind/minimum_trust filtering
conflict provenance handles lacked a hard member bound
independent_audit.repair_followup: first hard-cap repair exposed and then fixed a late-hidden-member scope-validation gap
independent_audit.notes: Final exact-tree read-only audit confirmed <=128 conflict members are all scope-validated, >128 fails closed, at most 16 matching handles are emitted with explicit truncation, filters/token caps remain intact, and no second DB/pool was introduced.
